utme_subjects: and two (2) other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes to include Yoruba and English Language.
direct_entry: Two (2) `A' Level passes to include Yoruba or Literature in English.

institution_waivers.note: DIRECT ENTRY: IBADAN accepts two (2) `A' Level passes to include Yoruba and another Arts or Social Science subject. It accepts NCE credit/merit in Yoruba and another Arts or Social Science subject.
DIRECT ENTRY: OAU accepts NCE merit in Yoruba.

DIRECT ENTRY: LAGOS accepts very good passes in three JUPEB/A' Level subjects in Yoruba/Igbo and any two of History, CRS/IRS, French, Government, Music, Visual Arts and Literature in English. NCE (Merit) in two subjects to include a Nigerian Language.
DIRECT ENTRY: ILORIN requires a) At least two (2) `A' Level passes to include Yoruba and any other Arts/Social Science; b) NCE/Diploma (Upper Credit) in Yoruba and Social Science subject.

UTME: IBADAN requires five (5) `O' Level credit passes at one sitting or six (6) `O' Level credit passes at two (2) sittings including English Language and two (2) Arts subjects, one of which must be Yoruba.

UTME: ILORIN accepts five (5) `O' Level credit passes to include Yoruba, English Language, Mathematics and two (2) other Arts/Social Science subjects. It also accepts candidates who do not offer Yoruba (Language/Literature) but meet other UTME entry requirements.
UTME: OAU requires five (5) `O' Level credit passes to include English Language and any Arts subject.
UTME: AAUA requires five (5) `O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Yoruba, Mathematics and any two subjects.
UTME: LAGOS requires five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any three Arts, Science or Social Sciences. Social Studies and Civic Education are also accepted.
UTME SUBJECTS: IBADAN requires Yoruba and two (2) other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences.
UTME SUBJECTS: OAU requires three (3) subjects from Arts and/or Social Sciences.
UTME SUBJECTS: OOU requires Yoruba and two (2) Arts subjects.
UTME SUBJECTS: ILORIN requires Yoruba and two (2) other subjects in Arts/Social Science.
UTME SUBJECTS: LAGOS requires English Language and any three Arts, Science or Social Sciences.
